subject: Confidential: rapid offboard plan for Tom Caldwell - action items
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-28T09:15:00Z
Subject: Confidential: rapid offboard plan for Tom Caldwell - action items

Team —

Following the conclusion of the internal review, leadership has decided to proceed with an involuntary termination for Tom Caldwell (Data Engineer). This must be handled as a short notice, confidential offboard. Key constraints: no prior notification to the employee, limited attendee list for the termination meeting, and preservation of audit trails.

High-level plan (please treat as confidential):
- Target termination meeting: Monday, 2026-08-03 at 10:00 PT (manager will do the call).
- Severance: provisional 8 weeks + COBRA enrollment guidance (Stephanie: please validate and confirm wording).
- Security/IT: disable SSO + VPN + revoke cloud console keys at 10:05 PT; prepare laptop retrieval/wipe plan (Aditya, see attached checklist).
- Payroll: confirm final paycheck, PTO payout, and timeline for severance disbursement (GlobalPayroll on cc).
- Legal/External counsel: Elena is on copy to review the termination letter; please confirm any last-minute compliance items.

Attachments: termination_letter_draft.pdf (HR draft), it-access-checklist.xlsx (Security/IT ops).

Immediate asks (action owners in parentheses):
1) Stephanie — finalize severance language and confirm the exact payment schedule by EOD today. Attach final termination letter for legal review.
2) Aditya — confirm the access-cutoff script and whether we can do a targeted snapshot of cloud logs and SSO events pre-cutoff. Add a device handling plan for laptop.
3) Rishi — confirm whether there are any pending equity/activity considerations, and if we need executive approval to proceed with the proposed severance.
4) Hannah — please prepare a short internal comms/registry entry template for PeopleOps to log (not for mass distribution).

This is time-sensitive; please use reply-all so we have a single record. I will loop the manager and keep the list intentionally small.

-Kim

Kimberly Park
Director, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: termination_letter_draft.pdf (PDF stub), it-access-checklist.xlsx (Excel stub)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morales <emoreales@beyondhr.com>, GlobalPayroll Support <support@globalpayroll.com>
Date: 2026-07-28T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Confidential: rapid offboard plan for Tom Caldwell - action items

Thanks, Kim — got it and understand the confidentiality requirement.

A few clarifying questions before I finalize the letter and severance schedule:
1) Confirm total target severance amount (8 weeks is provisionally approved by me today; I need the exact gross amount so I can populate the DocuSign template).
2) Is the termination contractual (cause/no cause)? Please confirm language we should use regarding references and unemployment eligibility.
3) Any special inventory items beyond the laptop (Yubikey, company phone, development keycards)? I assume standard device return.

I will draft the termination letter and run it by Elena for legal sign-off; Elena, can you review the draft when I send?

Date: 2026-07-28T12:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Confidential: rapid offboard plan for Tom Caldwell - action items

Kim and team —

I can own the access-cutoff and device workflow. Notes and constraints:
- Recommended cutoff window: disable SSO + revoke OAuth tokens + remove cloud console keys at T+5 mins (we'll schedule the script for 10:05 PT).
- We will take a read-only snapshot of GCP/AWS audit logs and SSO events covering the prior 72 hours and store them in a sealed bucket for legal review. That will be available by EOD Monday.
- Laptop: if the employee is remote, we need either a courier pickup or manager-hand-delivery to Ops. Suggest courier hold scheduled for same day; do NOT attempt remote wipe before retrieval unless we see active threat.
- YubiKey/company phone: mark as 'must-collect' in the checklist — I'll update the attached it-access-checklist.xlsx with device tags and steps.

Stephanie: I need the exact time window and a final list of accounts to disable (GitHub org, cloud consoles, internal admin groups). If you can confirm final participant list for the termination meeting that will help keep the audit limited.

Date: 2026-07-28T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Confidential: rapid offboard plan for Tom Caldwell - action items

Kim, Stephanie —

I provisionally approve the proposed 8-week severance, pending CFO confirmation if necessary; please flag if this deviates from our standard for the role. A few items for PeopleOps to include in the separation packet:
- Final PTO payout calculation and gross/net figures (Payroll).
- Confirmation there are no outstanding performance improvement or disciplinary doc obligations that would affect severance (we have the investigation notes; if Legal flags anything, let me know).
- Equity: standard plan states no accelerated vesting on termination; confirm equity team is notified to schedule final grant statement.

Also recommend we prepare a 20-minute post-exit sync (Ops + Security + HR + Manager) within 48 hours to close any outstanding entitlements and review the logs snapshot.

Date: 2026-07-29T09:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Confidential: rapid offboard plan for Tom Caldwell - action items

Thanks for the quick responses and offers to own. Confirming next steps and schedule:

1) Termination meeting confirmed for Monday, 2026-08-03 at 10:00 PT. Manager (Alex Martinez) will lead the meeting; attendees limited to manager + Stephanie + me (HR will be on the line for the call).
2) Security cutoff scheduled for 10:05 PT; Aditya will execute the revoke and snapshot.
3) Stephanie will finalize the termination letter and DocuSign route; please include Elena for legal review before sending.
4) Payroll (GlobalPayroll on cc) to confirm disbursement dates for severance and PTO payout — Stephanie, please confirm who will send the final numbers to them.
5) Device retrieval: courier scheduled for same day; Aditya, please confirm pickup window and wipe timeline.

Please do not escalate or share beyond this group. Stephanie — when you have the final draft, reply-all with the DocuSign link so Legal and Payroll can review.

-Kim

Date: 2026-07-29T18:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Confidential: rapid offboard plan for Tom Caldwell - action items — final draft attached

All —

Attached is the finalized termination letter draft (termination_letter_draft.pdf) with the severance schedule populated: 8 weeks gross, payable in a lump sum via GlobalPayroll within 15 business days of signed separation agreement. PTO payout amount and final gross/net calculations will be sent to GlobalPayroll by close of day tomorrow.

Elena — per our conversation, I incorporated the non-disparagement clause we discussed and removed the optional reference language. Please confirm legal sign-off by 10:00 AM PT Monday so we can route DocuSign immediately after the termination meeting.

Aditya — IT checklist has been updated with device tags and courier pickup instructions; please confirm pickup window (preferred: same-day).

Next steps (short checklist):
- Stephanie: route DocuSign to Tom for signature and copy to Legal/Payroll (once Elena signs off).
- Aditya: execute access revocation script at 10:05 PT on 2026-08-03 and upload logs to sealed bucket.
- Rishi/Kim: 20-minute post-exit sync scheduled for 2026-08-04 11:00 PT to confirm closure.

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

--
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: termination_letter_draft.pdf (PDF stub)
